info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Refunds-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Refunds Retrieval API enables users to efficiently search and retrieve refund details associated with retail orders. By accessing this endpoint, businesses can obtain comprehensive information regarding refunds, including status and amount, allowing for effective order management and customer service. Typical consumers of this API include retail managers and support agents who need timely access to refund information to address customer inquiries. This resource supports enhanced reporting and operational efficiency in managing customer refunds.

get.summary: Retrieve Refund Details for an Order
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a refund associated with a specific order. It provides essential information such as refund amount, reason, and status, enabling you to track the refund process effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund operation for an order. It should contain the necessary details to identify the order and the amount to be refunded.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing and will be completed shortly.

ListRetailOrdersRefundsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving order refund operations.

ListRetailOrdersRefundsResponse_202.title: Order Refund Response

status.description: Indicates if the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the refund.

resultId.description: The ID of the result for the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refund, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: An informational message about the refund operation.

ListRetailOrdersRefundsResponse_202.description: Response schema for the order refund operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the refund entry.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the audit of the refund operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds. This header indicates how long the server took to process the operation, allowing clients to assess the efficiency of the request.
